mechanism_claims.claim_text: Pinipesin showed no detectable heat with neutral POPC vesicles and only weak exothermic interaction with anionic POPC/POPG vesicles; the paper argues its antimicrobial activity might not involve significant peptide-membrane interaction.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Supports a negative/limited membrane-interaction finding, not a membrane-disruption mechanism claim.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Gel retardation did not show decreased bacterial DNA mobility as Pinipesin increased, so direct DNA binding is not supported by the local source.

source_locator.note: Fig. 7A and Supplementary Fig. S3 context re-opened.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Negative DNA-binding evidence only; it should not be converted to a positive nucleic-acid mechanism.
